name: muhkoo
description: Muhkoo's Claude Code plugins — build full applications on the Muhkoo platform.

plugins.name: muhkoo-app-builder
plugins.description: Describe an app idea and build it end-to-end on Muhkoo: provision the backend (ZK auth, database, channels, agents, functions), scaffold a Vite + React client against @muhkoo/connect, verify it with a live Cypress suite, apply a responsive frontend-design pass, and host it at <slug>.apps.muhkoo.dev.
